test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the given statements is/are CORRECT regarding Kochi port?

1. It is an artificial harbour situated on Willingdon Island.

2. It is located on the Arabian Sea, very close Suez-Colombo route.

3. It is located on islands within the Vembanad Lake, where it opens to the Arabian Sea..
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4: 1, 2, and 3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Statement 1:** Kochi Port is an artificial harbour situated on Willingdon Island.

 
 
• **Explanation:** Willingdon Island is a man-made island that serves as a major part of Kochi Port. It is one of the largest artificial harbours in India, constructed during the British era. ***Hence, statement 1 is correct.***
 
 
 
• **Statement 2:** It is located on the Arabian Sea, very close to the Suez-Colombo route.
 
 
• **Explanation:** The Kochi Port is strategically located on the western coast of India, along the Arabian Sea. Its proximity to the Suez-Colombo route makes it an important trade hub for international shipping. Hence, statement 2 is correct.&
